Crashes are rare. But the driving behaviors most associated with them often emerge as patterns over time — not isolated events.

Our new Compounding Risk Report uses Samsara’s patent-pending Risk Model to show how risk compounds when driving behaviors appear together and where it concentrates across a fleet. In the analysis, about half of crashes occurred among the 10% of drivers ranked highest by the model.

That clearer view helps safety leaders focus limited coaching time where it matters most and gives drivers more opportunities to build safer habits.

Read the report: https://lnkd.in/gmeghzSe

posts.content:
Where is your highest-value shipment right now? If your honest answer is somewhere between the last scan and here, you're not alone. 

David Gal, VP of Product & Engineering at Samsara, explains why that blind spot has been so hard to fix. RFID only works up close. GPS needs its own hardware. Bluetooth needed something it never had: a network already everywhere shipments go.

Samsara built that network, and it's what makes Tracking Label possible.

He talks it through with Dr. Angi Acocella of MIT Center for Transportation & Logistics' FreightLab and tech journalist Jason Del Rey on the MIT Supply Chain Frontiers Podcast, recorded live at Samsara Beyond 2026.

Listen to the full episode: https://lnkd.in/eQ4GUJmM
